# Feature vector, version 2

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_features_md.py from tools/features.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

**53 dimensions. Order and length are FROZEN.** Changing either after a checkpoint
exists silently breaks inference, because `feature_mean` and `feature_std` in the model
sidecar are tied to this exact order.

## Source of truth

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Reference implementation | `backend/tools/features.py` (reads the libclang AST from `tools/extract_ast.py`) |
| Feature count in C++ | `kFeatureCount` in `backend/src/ml/IPredictor.hpp` |
| C++ mirror (T4) | `FeatureExtractor`, plugged into the predictor with `setFeatureExtractor()` |

The C++ extractor must read **libclang cursors directly**, the same way `extract_ast.py` does.
The simplified AST schema in `tests/fixtures/ast-cfg-schema.md` is for the UI and the
complexity engine; it does not carry everything these features need.

**Validation rule:** Python and C++ must produce identical vectors on the same files.

## 0 to 9: Loop shape

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `loop_count` | `for`, `while`, `do` and range-for statements |
| 1 | `for_count` | `FOR_STMT` |
| 2 | `while_count` | `WHILE_STMT` and `DO_STMT` |
| 3 | `rangefor_count` | `CXX_FOR_RANGE_STMT` |
| 4 | `max_nest_depth` | Deepest loop nesting. A single loop is 1 |
| 5 | `loop_bound_size_call` | Loops whose first 40 tokens contain `.size()` or `size_t` |
| 6 | `loop_bound_var` | `loop_count - loop_bound_size_call` |
| 7 | `loop_from_i_plus_1` | Loops whose first 40 tokens (spaces removed) contain `+1`. The tokens include the start of nested loops, so an outer loop can fire too |
| 8 | `loop_step_halving` | Loop tokens contain `/2` or `>>1` |
| 9 | `loop_step_doubling` | Loop tokens contain `*2` or `<<1` |

## 10 to 13: Functions and recursion

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | `has_recursion` | 1 if any function's name appears as a call, else 0 |
| 11 | `recursive_fn_count` | Number of functions that call themselves |
| 12 | `self_call_count` | Number of calls to those functions |
| 13 | `fn_count` | `FUNCTION_DECL` |

## 14 to 20: Control flow

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 14 | `if_count` | `IF_STMT` |
| 15 | `else_count` | `if` statements with an `else` part |
| 16 | `ternary_count` | `CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR` (`a ? b : c`) |
| 17 | `switch_count` | `SWITCH_STMT` |
| 18 | `break_count` | `BREAK_STMT` |
| 19 | `continue_count` | `CONTINUE_STMT` |
| 20 | `cyclomatic` | Decision points: `if_count + loop_count + ternary_count + switch_count + 1`. Not `edges - nodes + 2` |

## 21 to 31: Containers (declarations only)

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | `vector_count` | Declared type contains `vector<` but not `vector<vector<` |
| 22 | `vector2d_count` | Declared type contains `vector<vector<` |
| 23 | `set_count` | Type contains `set<` but not `unordered_set<` |
| 24 | `unordered_set_count` | Type contains `unordered_set<` |
| 25 | `map_count` | Type contains `map<` but not `unordered_map<` |
| 26 | `unordered_map_count` | Type contains `unordered_map<` |
| 27 | `queue_count` | Type contains `queue<` but not `priority_queue<` |
| 28 | `stack_count` | Type contains `stack<` |
| 29 | `priority_queue_count` | Type contains `priority_queue<` |
| 30 | `string_count` | Type contains `string` |
| 31 | `pair_count` | Type contains `pair<` |

## 32 to 38: STL calls

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 32 | `sort_calls` | Calls named `sort` |
| 33 | `lower_bound_calls` | Calls named `lower_bound` |
| 34 | `upper_bound_calls` | Calls named `upper_bound` |
| 35 | `find_calls` | Calls named `find` |
| 36 | `max_element_calls` | Calls named `max_element` or `min_element` |

## 39 to 44: Index and access patterns

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 39 | `array_access_count` | `ARRAY_SUBSCRIPT_EXPR` (raw arrays) plus `CALL_EXPR` named `operator[]` (vector and map indexing) |
| 40 | `index_i` | Index text is exactly `i`, `idx` or `p` |
| 41 | `index_i_plus_1` | Index text contains `+ 1` or `+1` |
| 42 | `index_i_minus_1` | Index text contains `- 1` or `-1` |
| 43 | `index_mid` | Index text contains `mid` or `middle` |
| 44 | `two_index_same_array` | Number of arrays (by base text) indexed with 2 or more different index texts |

## 45 to 47: Arithmetic and comparison

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 45 | `add_sub_count` | `BINARY_OPERATOR` with `+` or `-`. Compound assignments (`+=`) are a different cursor kind and are not counted |
| 46 | `mul_div_count` | `BINARY_OPERATOR` with `*`, `/` or `%` |
| 47 | `compare_count` | `BINARY_OPERATOR` with `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `==` or `!=` |

## 48 to 52: Pointer movement (added in v2)

| idx | name | how it is computed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 48 | `loop_cond_two_vars` | Loops whose condition compares two different variables that are both modified inside the loop (`l < r`) |
| 49 | `inc_and_dec_in_loop` | Loops where one variable gets `++` and a different one gets `--` |
| 50 | `running_add_sub` | Variables that get both `x += <array access>` and `x -= <array access>`, plus statements `x += a[..] - a[..]` |
| 51 | `index_minus_var` | Array accesses whose index is a name minus a name (`a[i - k]`, not `a[i - 1]`) |
| 52 | `inner_while_no_reset` | `while` loops nested in another loop whose condition variables are not declared in an earlier sibling statement |

## Rules that apply to several features

- Only cursors from the user's file are walked; system headers are skipped.
- Loop text features read the first 40 tokens of the loop statement.
- Container features count declarations only (`VAR_DECL`, `PARM_DECL`, `FIELD_DECL`), using the declared type spelling with spaces removed.
- Call features use the call's spelling; for member calls with an empty spelling, the `MEMBER_REF_EXPR` name.
- Index text is the token text of the index sub-expression, joined with single spaces.
